reviewedFacts: Start28 validates skill/missile/duration/state, removes/replaces its own state, allocates a self curse/stat list, writes modifier skill/level and toggles graphics. The current row has no aura stat slots, so the shared six-slot writer has no inferred damage snapshot.

Do54 rejects missing skill/state/learned context, skips periodic damage in town and calls full Do142 outside town. Do142 obtains progressive range or falls back to current aurarangecalc, rolls physical/elemental skill damage once into copied area data, then enumerates aura-filtered targets.

Each full callback copies that skill packet, performs a separate hit/result check and, only on success, fills current weapon damage with source fraction, allocates combat and dispatches durability/event delivery. Do not replace this with automatic spell damage or assume the missile attachment owns gameplay damage.

Current data gives27+2*(effective rank-1)mana,3000+300*(rank-1)duration frames, perdelay25, radius parameter6 source units, SrcDam96/128 and hard Sentinel/Fury synergy10% each. The visual attachment has Half2HSrc1, but that flag alone does not prove halving the separate Do142 melee weapon callback.

The literal reconstructed periodic expression is delay*(frame+delay-1)/delay+1, with minimum delay5. In bounded nonoverflow arithmetic this is frame+delay; do not invent a globally aligned pulse grid from its name.
